<!-- GENERATED by templates/tools/build-commands.ps1 from commands/stage-08-uat-readiness.md - do not edit by hand. -->

The project folder, if one was given: `$ARGUMENTS`. If it is empty, use the project in the
current directory and say which one you picked.

**Load the `uc-delivery` skill and run its stage 8.** Its gate is **L4** — a real job, with
state, logs and the SDD acceptance table. **L4-local does not substitute**, and this is the one
stage where that distinction is the whole point.

Confirm, item by item, each with its evidence:

- every SDD requirement traces to a workflow **and** a test case;
- every `APPROX_SELECTOR` / `TODO_SELECTOR` in every `*.selectors-todo.md` is resolved against
  the live application;
- `Config_TST.xlsx` has no remaining `[UC-SPECIFIC — replace]`;
- `Documentation/Leaf_Ledger.md` reads `yes` in every column of every row;
- `Tests/RunAllTests.xaml` passes.

Run the conformance checker in its **stage-8 mode** (the `--uat-readiness` / `-UatReadiness`
switch, per `project-scaffolding`), which promotes `leaf-body-stub` to an error — **a leaf
workflow whose body does nothing is not shippable.** It must run clean, or every suppressed rule
has a written reason in `validate-project.ignore`.

Also require a clean analyzer result, **naming which rule set ran**.

**Read the application state back independently of the robot's logs.** A green job with a
non-zero transaction count is exactly what a stub-bodied automation produces — it is not
evidence that anything happened in the application.

List anything still open as a **named blocker**, not a soft caveat. Update
`Documentation/Progress.md` with the level reached and the job evidence.
